summary:
The PR reorganizes the invoice creation form using progressive disclosure while preserving existing invoice payload and default-assignment behavior.
- Adds a reusable, accessible collapsible-section component with conditional content mounting.
- Groups debt, counterparty, default-location, notes, and attachment controls into collapsed sections.
- Adds Arabic section labels and comprehensive unit and end-to-end coverage for disclosure state and full invoice creation.
confidenceReasoning:
The PR appears safe to merge with no concrete blocking or independently actionable non-blocking issue identified.

The new sections preserve form values in page-level state, remain stable across line-item rerenders, retain the existing submission behavior, and are covered through unit and end-to-end tests.
